docs.title: Introduction
docs.text: USER GUIDE

docs.title: Welcome to Centrad
docs.text:
A web portal for managing a vehicle fleet. See where your vehicles are, watch live and recorded video, review events, keep evidence and run reports.

Start the quick start Browse all topics

docs.text:

docs.title: AI Insights
docs.text: Ask questions about your data.

docs.title: Ask a question
docs.text:
1. Open AI Insights.
  2. Type your question in Ask a question about your data.
  3. Click Execute.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:

  • Dashboard
  • Cenhub Assistant

docs.title: Cenhub Assistant
docs.text: Ask questions and get answers without leaving the portal. The assistant is an AI chat that is available on every page.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text: • The assistant must be turned on for your account. If you don't see the chat button, ask your administrator.

docs.title: Ask a question
docs.text:
1. Open the chat window from the chat button on any page.
  2. Type your question in Ask a question.
  3. Press Enter, or click the send button at the bottom right of the window.

The answer appears in the chat window. You can keep asking follow-up questions in the same conversation.

docs.title: The chat window
docs.text:
• Name and status (top left): the assistant's name. A green dot and Online show it is ready.
  • Switch assistant (top right): click the arrows button to choose a different assistant from the list.
  • Close (top right): click X to close the chat window. Your page stays as it was.

Note

The assistant is powered by AI. Check important answers before you act on them.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• AI Insights
  • Sign in and find your way around

docs.title: Dashboard
docs.text: See your whole fleet at a glance: vehicles, online and offline, cameras, events and fleet health. It is the first page you see after you sign in.

docs.title: On the page
docs.text:
• Tiles: Total vehicles, Online, Offline, Cameras online, AI events and Evidence requests. Percentages show the share of the fleet.
  • Fleet location: a map of your vehicles, with a legend for Online, Offline and Alarm.
  • Events requiring attention: events waiting for review. Click View all to see them.
  • Fleet health (CEN checks): the share of the fleet that is healthy, with counts for Recording OK, Camera faults, Device offline and GPS lost. Click View details for more.

docs.title: Change what the page shows
docs.text:
• Click Customise to choose what the page shows.
  • Use the New / Classic switch at the top right to change layout.

docs.title: Classic dashboard
docs.text:
Click Classic to switch to the classic layout.

  • Period buttons: choose Today, Yesterday, Week, Month or Custom. The page notes that the period only changes the active and inactive split. Camera health and recording health always show today's status, and Event Center totals are not filtered by date.
  • Fleet Overview: the total number of devices, and how many are active and inactive. Click More info for details.
  • Event Center: three cards for events that were reviewed with no further action, events that need review, and events reviewed where action is required.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Live Tracking
  • Event Center
  • Evidence Locker

docs.title: Evidence Locker
docs.text: Keep a record of an incident, with its details and files.

docs.title: The list
docs.text: The list shows IncidentName, IncidentDescription, RegistrationNumber, DriverName, IncidentDate, ExpiryDate and Files. Use the search box to find a record.

docs.title: Add evidence
docs.text:
1. Click Create New.
  2. Fill in Incident Name, Incident Description and Registration Number. These are required. Add the Driver Name if you have it.
  3. Choose the Incident Date and the Expiry Date. Both are required.
  4. Under Attach file, click Local File, Events File or Video Download File to add files. Added files appear in a table with Action, Filename and Source.
  5. Click Save. Click Back to List to leave without saving.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Video Downloads
  • Event Center
  • Add evidence (quick start)

docs.title: Geofence
docs.text: Create and manage geofences on a map. A geofence is an area you draw on the map.

docs.title: On the page
docs.text:
• New: start a new geofence.
  • Bulk Import: add several geofences at once.
  • Search geofences: find one in the list. When there are none, the list says No geofences created yet.
  • Show All: a tick box above the list.

The tools at the top left of the map include a search tool and drawing tools. The buttons at the top right change the map layers and make the map full screen.

docs.title: Glossary
docs.text:
Words you will see in the portal, in plain language.

Vehicles and maps Video Events and the dashboard Records and checks

docs.title: Vehicles and maps
docs.text:
• Vehicle, device, unit

    The items listed in Live Tracking, Live Video and Asset Management. Each has a device name, and usually a registration.

    See Live Tracking

  • Group

    A heading that vehicles are listed under, for example Tamworth. A group can have a parent group.

    See Asset Management

  • Online, Offline, Alarm

    The map legend. Green is online, red is offline and orange is alarm.

    See Live Tracking

  • Geofence

    An area you draw on the map.

    See Geofence

docs.title: Video
docs.text:
• Channel

    One camera on a vehicle. Video Playback shows one timeline row for each channel.

    See Video Playback

  • Stream

    In Video Playback, the quality of the video: High quality or Low bandwidth.

    See Video Playback

  • Subject

    Optional text that describes a video clip you request.

    See Video Downloads

docs.title: Events and the dashboard
docs.text:
• Event

    An entry in the Event Center, for example Harsh Braking. It shows a status, device, driver, channel and address.

    See Event Center

  • AI events

    A dashboard tile that counts events needing review.

    See Dashboard

  • Evidence request

    A dashboard tile that counts evidence requests, and how many are still processing.

    See Dashboard

  • Fleet health (CEN checks)

    A dashboard panel that counts Recording OK, Camera faults, Device offline and GPS lost.

    See Dashboard

docs.title: Records and checks
docs.text:
• Evidence

    An incident record in the Evidence Locker, with its details and attached files.

    See Evidence Locker

  • Template

    A CEN Check form. Each template shows its forms and the vehicles it is assigned to.

    See Template

  • Completed template

    A check that has been filled in. It appears under CEN Check > Completed Templates.

    See Completed Templates

  • Notification Hub

    The list of notifications on the Notifications page. Each has a type, such as Report, Event or Service / MOT.

    See Notifications

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Introduction
  • Quick start

docs.title: Notifications
docs.text: The Notification Hub lists your notifications and how each one works.

docs.title: On the page
docs.text:
• Click Create New to add a notification.
  • Click Edit on a row to change it.
  • Use the search box to find one.

docs.title: What each row shows
docs.text: Column What it shows Name For example Abnormal storage report, Harsh Braking or Video loss alert, with a short description under it. Type For example Report, Event or Service / MOT. Targets How many units it covers, for example 8 units. Actions How you are told, for example Email. Schedule For example Scheduled. Active Yes when it is switched on.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Reports
  • Event Center

docs.title: Reports
docs.text: Run a report for the vehicles and dates you choose.

docs.title: Run a report
docs.text:
1. Open Reports.
  2. In the first drop-down, choose the report. The page opens on Alarms Report.
  3. Click Select date range and choose the dates.
  4. In the alarm drop-down, choose which alarm you want. It starts on All alarm.
  5. On the left, tick the groups or vehicles to include. Use Search to find one.
  6. Read the results in the table.
  7. Click Export to save them.

The columns include Device ID, Device Name, Group Name, Alarm, Description, Content, GPS Time and Speed.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Notifications
  • Trips
  • Event Center

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text: What you need before you start.

docs.title: What you need
docs.text:
• An account

    A username and password. No account yet? Click Request access on the sign-in page.

  • A web browser

    The latest Chrome, Edge or Safari, as the sign-in page recommends.

  • A way back in

    Forgot your password? Click Forgot password? next to the Password field on the sign-in page.

  • Remember me

    Tick Remember me on this device above the Sign in button if you want the portal to remember you on that device.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• You have your username and password.
  • You are using the latest Chrome, Edge or Safari.
  • You can open the portal's sign-in page.

docs.text:

docs.title: User Logs
docs.text: See when users last used the portal.

docs.title: On the page
docs.text:
• Type in the search box to find a user.
  • Click Export to Excel or Export to PDF to save the list.

The columns are Log, User, Action (for example Logged in) and Last Visit.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • User Masters

docs.title: Completed Templates
docs.text: See the checks that have been completed.

docs.title: On the page
docs.text:
• Click Download on a row to save a completed check.
  • Use the search box to find a row.

The columns are Action, Name, Description, Device Name, Driver Name, Status and CompletedDate.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • Template

docs.title: Template
docs.text: See your CEN Check templates and add new ones.

docs.title: The list
docs.text:
• Click Create New to add a template.
  • Under Forms, click the eye icon to see a template's forms.
  • Under Assigned Vehicle, click the eye icon to see the vehicles it is assigned to.
  • Use the search box to find a template.

The other columns are Action (an Edit button), Name, Description and AllowOtherDriverNotes (a tick or a cross).

docs.title: Add a template
docs.text:
1. Click Create New.
  2. Type a Name and a Description.
  3. Tick AllowOtherDriverNotes if you need it.
  4. Click Save. Click Back to List to leave without saving.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Completed Templates
  • Asset Management

docs.title: Asset Management
docs.text:
See your units (vehicles) and your unit groups.

Three boxes at the top show Total Units, Active Units and Unit Groups. Below them are two tabs: Units and Unit Groups.

docs.title: Units
docs.text:
• Type in Search units to find a unit.
  • Click Create New to add one.

The columns are Action (an Edit button), Device (the name and ID), Registration, Group, Hardware Type, Model, Comm Type, Channels and Active.

docs.title: Unit Groups
docs.text:
Click the Unit Groups tab.

  • Type in Search groups to find a group.
  • Click Create New to add one.

The columns are Action, Group Name, Description, Parent Group and Units, which is the number of units in the group.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Manage Vehicles
  • Live Tracking
  • User Masters

docs.title: Manage Vehicles
docs.text: A register of vehicles. Open it with the Manage vehicles link on the Dashboard. Its page heading is Asset Management, but it is a different page from Asset Management in the Configurations menu.

docs.title: On the page
docs.text:
• Click Create New to add a vehicle.
  • The columns include RegistrationNumber, Co2Emissions, Colour, EngineCapacity, FuelType, MonthOfFirstRegistration, MotStatus, MotexpiryDate and TaxDueDate.

The list was empty when this page was captured, so the screenshot shows only the column headings.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Asset Management
  • Dashboard

docs.title: System Settings
docs.text:
Choose how speeds, distances, dates and times are shown.

The page has three tabs: Units & Formats, Map and Video.

docs.title: Change the units and formats
docs.text:
1. Open Configurations > System Settings.
  2. Under Measurement System, choose Imperial (miles and miles per hour) or Metric (kilometres and kilometres per hour). The page says this applies to every speed, distance and odometer reading in the portal. It also says changing it only changes how existing history is shown, not the history itself.
  3. Under Date & Time Format, choose a Date Format (for example 31/07/2026 (dd/MM/yyyy)) and a Time Format (for example 14:30:05 (24-hour, with seconds)).
  4. Check Preview. It shows how a date and time, a speed and a distance will look.
  5. Click Save Settings.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• User Masters
  • Reports

docs.title: User Masters
docs.text: See the portal's users and add new ones.

docs.title: The list
docs.text:
Use the search box to find a user. Click Edit on a row to change that user, or Create New to add one.

The list shows User Name, First Name, Last Name, Email, Contact Number, Active Status, Time Out Status and Ticketing.

docs.title: Create a user
docs.text:
1. Click Create New.
  2. Tick the User type: Portal, Driver or Planner.
  3. On the User tab, fill in User Name, First Name, Last Name and Email. These are required.
  4. Choose the User Role. Add the Contact Number and Ticketing User Id if you need them.
  5. Type the Password, and type it again in Confirm password.
  6. Choose the OTP Method. It starts on Disable.
  7. Set Active Status, Time Out Status and All Support Tickets. The first two start ticked.
  8. Click Save. Click Back to List to leave without saving.

The form also has Depot Permissions and Map tabs.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Asset Management
  • User Logs
  • System Settings

docs.title: Live Tracking
docs.text: See where your vehicles are, on a map and in a list grouped by area.

docs.title: Find a vehicle
docs.text:
1. Open Monitoring > Live Tracking.
  2. Type in Search, or click a group's arrow to open it.
  3. Find your vehicle in the list. Its icon shows if it is online or offline.

Click the A-Z button to change the sort order.

docs.title: On the map
docs.text:
• Each vehicle is shown with its name.
  • The legend at the top left explains the colours: green is Online, red is Offline and orange is Alarm.
  • A Locator button sits at the top of the map.
  • The buttons at the top right change the map layers and make the map full screen.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Trips
  • Live Video
  • Dashboard

docs.title: Trips
docs.text: Look at a vehicle's trips for a date you choose.

docs.title: See a vehicle's trips
docs.text:
1. Open Monitoring > Trips.
  2. Use Search to find and select a vehicle.
  3. Choose Calendar View or List View.
  4. In the calendar, pick a date. Use the arrows to change month.

Until you choose, the page shows Select a vehicle and date to see trip details.

docs.title: On the page
docs.text:
• A map shows the area, with the same legend as Live Tracking.
  • A timeline at the bottom runs from 00:00 to 23:00 and has a Speed row.
  • Buttons under the calendar include pause, stop, zoom in and zoom out.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Live Tracking
  • Video Playback
  • Reports

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
Five short walkthroughs for the first things most people do. Each one ends with a link to the full page.

  1. Sign in and find your way around
  2. Find a vehicle on the map
  3. Watch live video
  4. Request a video clip
  5. Add evidence

docs.title: Add evidence
docs.text:
1. Open Evidence Locker and click Create New.
  2. Fill in the fields marked with a star, and choose the dates.
  3. Under Attach file, add your files.
  4. Click Save.

Full details: Evidence Locker.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Evidence Locker
  • Video Downloads
  • Event Center

docs.title: Find a vehicle on the map
Find a vehicle on the map
docs.text:
1. Open Monitoring > Live Tracking.
  2. Type in Search, or click a group in the list on the left to open it.
  3. Find your vehicle in the list. The map shows each vehicle with its name.

A green vehicle is online. A red vehicle is offline.

Full details: Live Tracking.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Live Tracking
  • Trips
  • Live Video

docs.title: Request a video clip
docs.text:
1. Open Video Management > Video Downloads.
  2. Under Request Video, choose the Device Name, the Date and time, and the Duration Minutes.
  3. If you like, add a Subject and tick Email me the video link when ready.
  4. Click Request Footage.
  5. Find your request under Downloaded Videos. When Status shows Completed, click Play.

Full details: Video Downloads.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Video Downloads
  • Video Playback
  • Evidence Locker

docs.title: Sign in and find your way around
Sign in and find your way around
docs.text: Sign in, then use the menu on the left to open any page.

docs.title: Sign in
docs.text:
1. Type your Username.
  2. Type your Password.
  3. Click Sign in.

Need an account? Click Request access. The sign-in page also has Forgot password? and a Remember me on this device tick box.

docs.title: Find your way around
docs.text:
• Menu (left): Dashboard, Monitoring, Video Management, Evidence Locker, Geofence, CEN Check, Notifications, Reports, Configurations, Audit Log and AI Insights. A small arrow means the item opens to show more pages.
  • Top right: the notification bell and your user name.
  • Bottom right: a round chat button that opens the Cenhub Assistant.

After you sign in you land on the Dashboard.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Dashboard
  • Requirements

docs.title: Watch live video
docs.text:
1. Open Video Management > Live Video.
  2. Find the vehicle in the list on the left, or on the map.
  3. Double-click the device. The video appears on the right, marked LIVE.
  4. Click Previous or Next to change channel.

Full details: Live Video.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Live Video
  • Video Playback
  • Live Tracking

docs.title: Event Center
docs.text: Review recorded events and watch their video.

docs.title: Watch an event
docs.text:
1. Open Video Management > Event Center.
  2. Find the event in the list.
  3. Click Play on its row.

docs.title: Find and save events
docs.text:
• Type in Search events to search the list.
  • Click Filters to narrow the list.
  • Click Export to save the list.
  • Use the number box to choose how many rows to show, and Previous and Next to change page.

docs.title: What each row shows
docs.text: Column What it shows Status For example Completed. Event Type For example Harsh Braking. Device Name The vehicle. Driver The driver for the event. Channel The camera channel. Address Where the event happened.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Video Downloads
  • Evidence Locker
  • Dashboard

docs.title: Live Video
docs.text: Watch a vehicle's cameras live.

docs.title: Start live video
docs.text:
1. Open Video Management > Live Video.
  2. Find the vehicle in the list on the left, or on the map. Use Search and A-Z to find it quickly.
  3. Double-click the device.
  4. The video appears in the panel on the right, marked LIVE.
  5. Click Previous or Next to change channel.

Before you start, the panel says Double-click a device to start live video.

docs.title: On the page
docs.text:
• The speaker icon controls the sound. The camera icon is next to it.
  • The red arrows between the panels fold the list and the map away, to give the video more room.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Video Playback
  • Live Tracking
  • Video Downloads

docs.title: Video Downloads
docs.text: Request a video clip, then watch it from your list of requests.

docs.title: Request a clip
docs.text:
Under Request Video:

  1. Choose the Device Name.
  2. Choose the Date and time the clip should start.
  3. Set the Duration Minutes.
  4. If you like, type a Subject to describe the clip.
  5. Tick Email me the video link when ready if you want an email.
  6. Click Request Footage.

docs.title: Watch your clip
docs.text: Your requests are listed under Downloaded Videos. When Status shows Completed, click Play.

docs.title: Find and save requests
docs.text:
• Type in Search downloads to search the list.
  • Click Filters to narrow the list.
  • Click Export to save the list.

The columns are Action, Status, Device Name, No. of Channel(s), Date From, Date To, Subject and Created Date.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Video Playback
  • Event Center
  • Evidence Locker

docs.title: Video Playback
docs.text: Watch recorded video for a vehicle and a date.

docs.title: Play a recording
docs.text:
1. Open Video Management > Video Playback.
  2. Use Search to find and select a device.
  3. Under Stream, choose High quality or Low bandwidth.
  4. Choose Calendar View or List View.
  5. Under Channels, keep All ticked, or choose the channels you want.
  6. Double-click a date to start playback.

Before you start, the video area says Click a device, select channels, then double-click a date in Calendar or List view to play.

docs.title: On the page
docs.text:
• Buttons under Channels include pause, stop, sound, zoom in and zoom out.
  • The timeline at the bottom has one row for each channel and runs from 00:00 to 23:00.
  • A map on the right shows the area.

docs.text:
